name: Kelly Franklin
bio: Kelly manages the day-to-day operations of the newsroom from San Diego. She came to Classic Reporters after five years at a Pacific daily desk, where she moved from city-desk reporter to assistant managing editor. She focuses on the politics and copy desks, coordinates the flow of daily assignments, and keeps the newsroom's coverage clear, accurate, and on schedule.
